selection_method: Manual, bounded selection after a read-only structural scan of the pinned docs tree; only these files are normalized and chunked.

reasons: code must remain attached to explanatory text
English half of a translation pair
Spanish half of a translation pair
same code examples as English without deduplication
raw HTML line breaks inside technical table cells
test that removed navigation remains metadata
must be excluded with an explicit reason and produce no chunks
tests retaining a complete technical fact
approved Liquid help and important includes

coverage_notes.redirect_page: This snapshot uses Jekyll redirect_from front matter rather than redirect_to-only pages. docs/cmake-options.md and other selected pages exercise the real redirect mechanism: the old route is recorded as an alias on the semantic destination, not emitted as a separate document.
coverage_notes.bounded_scope: 12 of 912 docs/**/*.md files are processed. Include files are read only when referenced by these pages and never become standalone documents.
